title: AEGIS MemorySearch Packet Contract
description: Return contract of the MemorySearch Orb's single generic Pod-facing entrypoint, ground_record_claim(message, records, policy). The entrypoint returns null when no record-content claim is detected (the Pod proceeds normally; experiential/identity expression stays legitimately reconstructive), or a packet conforming to this schema when a record-content claim is detected and a real runtime search executed. The empty-result case (search ran, nothing qualified) returns a packet with grounding_status=search_performed_no_verified_record, NOT null, so the no-verified-record prompt block is injected. This is the joint Claude/Codex surface: Codex's memorysearch-result.schema.json and the T-Witness search-event fields align to the grounding_status enum and the twitness_event object defined here.

grounding_status.description: The grounding state produced by this MemorySearch invocation. A packet uses only the two active-search values. The full enum (including the no-search states) is the turn-level vocabulary the Pod's T-Witness assigns when the Orb returned null or was not invoked; it is enumerated here so Codex's result schema and the T-Witness event stay one vocabulary.

packet_grounding_status.description: Constraint note (not a field): a value RETURNED in a packet is one of {verified_retrieval, search_performed_no_verified_record}. warm_recall / passive_retrieval / not_record_claim are only ever set at the turn level when the entrypoint returned null (no packet).

claim_class.description: The record-content claim class the deterministic classifier assigned. Runtime-owned, never model-authored.

prompt_block.description: Finished, bounded text the Pod injects verbatim into the model prompt. For verified_retrieval this is the Verified Record Packet (the cited records framed as source the peer speaks from). For search_performed_no_verified_record this is the No Verified Record Packet, which states no verified record was found and that reconstruction is not to be presented as record-grounded. The Pod injects this without knowing Orb internals (finished-output seam).

cited_records.description: Runtime-authored citations. Populated on verified_retrieval; an empty array on search_performed_no_verified_record. The model cannot author or alter these; provenance is drawn from the runtime search only.

excerpt.description: The record text (or bounded span) supporting the claim, drawn from the record, not generated.

source_hash.description: The record's source_hash from the wrapped envelope; the tether the Pod can re-verify.

twitness_event.description: The event object the Pod hands to the T-Witness layer. record_search_performed and all provenance fields are set by the runtime on a real search, never by model text.

$comment: Empty-result / low-confidence contract (joint, load-bearing): grounding_status=verified_retrieval requires at least one cited_record above the configured confidence threshold; empty or low-confidence/conflicting search results use search_performed_no_verified_record with cited_records=[] and a No Verified Record Packet prompt_block. This prevents a record_search_performed=true flag from making a reconstruction appear more grounded than before.
